description.narrative: Bangladesh has a long-standing commitment to advancing social protection. To address those issues, the government formulated the National Social Security Strategy (NSSS) for 2015-2026, providing a long-term vision for developing a social protection system in Bangladesh. To implement the NSSS, the government adopted the NSSS action plans (Phase I, 2015 2020; Phase II, 2021 2026) that focus on institutional and program reforms of social protection. Aligned with the Phase II action plan of NSSS, ADB supported Bangladesh through the Second Strengthening Social Resilience Program under a programmatic approach to enhance the country's social protection system. It focused on (i) improving efficiency in social protection program management, (ii) strengthening protection for critical vulnerabilities, and (iii) strengthening preventive capacity of social protection to reduce the risks of falling into poverty. Subprogram 1 strengthened the enabling environment and facilitated essential reforms. Building on the achievement under subprogram 1, subprogram 2 aims to operationalize and institutionalize reforms for improved efficiency and effectiveness of the social protection in Bangladesh.
